4279-4314-7452--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
4279-4314-7452--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Cauldron of Essence, Pawn of Ulamog and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron of Essence trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Pawn of Ulamog ability, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Cauldron of Essence triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

147-1070-5256.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-1070-5256.description:
Cast Rise Again by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Rise Again.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, causing a player to mill card(s).
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Rise Again
Resolve the Rise Again copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

2866-3200-4247-4986.description:
Cast Urza's Bauble by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Urza's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Urza's Bauble from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

1496-1981-2415-6495.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1496-1981-2415-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Verdant Sun's Avatar triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
1496-1981-2415-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

2111-2921-4981.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Wingrattle Scarecrow
When Wingrattle Scarecrow dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Wingrattle Scarecrow enters, Serra Redeemer triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Wingrattle Scarecrow
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

1409-5424-7824.description:
Activate Sailor of Means by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Sailor of Means enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Sailor of Means.
Resolve the Sailor of Means trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

2724-2963-6432.description:
Blink Wormfang Manta using Teleportation Circle. Wormfang Manta's first ability won't trigger due to Doorkeeper Thrull.
Wormfang Manta's second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

618-1517-4456-7494.easyPrerequisites: The Mirari Conjecture's third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
618-1517-4456-7494.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, copying Blazing Firesinger. It'll enter prepared due to its effect.
Cast a copy of Seething Song by paying {2}{R}.
The Mirari Conjecture and Hematite Talisman trigger.
Resolve the The Mirari Conjecture trigger, copying Seething Song.
Resolve the copy of Seething Song, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Hematite Talisman trigger, causing you to pay {3} to untap Kiki-Jiki.
Resolve the original Seething Song, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

413-5088-5211-7443-7537.notablePrerequisites:
You control eight or more lands.
Any one opponent cannot block and kill Emeritus of Abundance this turn.
413-5088-5211-7443-7537.description:
Cast Brass's Bounty by paying {6}{R}, creating at least eight Treasure tokens.
Activate two of those Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding two mana.
Cast a copy of Regrowth from exile by paying {1}{G}, targeting Brass's Bounty.
Pyromancer's Ascension's first ability triggers, allowing you to put a quest counter on it.
Resolve the copy of Regrowth, returning Brass's Bounty from your graveyard to your hand.
Declare Emeritus of Abundance as an attacker.
When Emeritus of Abundance attacks, it triggers, becoming prepared.
During your second main phase, activate your remaining Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding at least six mana.
Cast a copy of Regrowth by paying {1}{G}, targeting the actual Regrowth card.
Pyromancer Ascension's first ability triggers, allowing you to put a quest counter on it.
Resolve the copy of Regrowth, returning Regrowth from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Brass's Bounty by paying {6}{R}.
Pyromancer Ascension's second ability triggers, copying Brass's Bounty.
Resolve both copies of Brass's Bounty, creating at least sixteen Treasure tokens.
Activate those Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding at least sixteen mana.
Activate Blasting Station by sacrificing Emeritus of Abundance and tapping it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast the card Regrowth from your hand by paying {1}{G}, targeting Emeritus of Abundance.
Pyromancer Ascension's second ability triggers, copying Regrowth and allowing you to target Brass's Bounty with the copy.
Resolve both copies of Regrowth, returning Emeritus of Abundance and Brass's Bounty from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Brass's Bounty by paying its mana cost.
Pyromancer Ascension's second ability triggers, copying Brass's Bounty.
Resolve both copies of Brass's Bounty, creating at least sixteen Treasure tokens.
Activate those Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding at least sixteen mana.
Cast Emeritus of Abundance by paying {2}{G}.
When Emeritus of Abundance enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping it.
Cast a copy of Regrowth from exile by paying {1}{G}, targeting Brass's Bounty.
Both of Pyromancer Ascension's abilities trigger.
In response, activate Blasting Station by sacrificing Emeritus of Ideation and tapping it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve Pyromancer Ascension's first abiliity, putting a redundant quest counter on it if desired.
Resolve Pyromancer Ascension's second ability, copying Regrowth and targeting Emeritus of Abundance with the copy.
Repeat from step 19.

Gain life.

When the Servo enters, Auriok Champion triggers, causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the The Destined White Mage trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control

141-2906-7301.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents have lost at least 2 life this turn.
141-2906-7301.description:
Cast Avatar's Wrath by paying its mana cost, targeting Rakdos

Resolve Avatar's Wrath, airbending Naru Meha.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha from exile by paying {0} due to Rakdos.

2281-5231-5237.easyPrerequisites: You had a permanent leave the battlefield this turn.

Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Renegade Rallier
When Renegade Rallier dies, Saffi triggers, returning Renegade Rallier from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Renegade Rallier enters, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1090-6406-6867.description:
Cast Appa either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{W}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Restoration Angel with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Restoration Angel from exile by paying {1} and tapping Appa.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When Restoration Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Restoration Angel with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Restoration Angel from exile by paying {0} and tapping Appa and the Ally token.
Repeat from step 4.
1090-6406-6867.notes: If you control another creature, you can reduce the cost by {1} and tap that creature in step 3 instead of paying mana.

5805-6798--5.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the creature with persist.
The persist ability triggers, returning that creature to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it, as well as a +1/+1 counter due to Gev.
The +1/+1 and -1/-1 counters on that creature are removed as a state-based action.
Resolve the ability from step 1.
Repeat.

4947-5078-5295-6766.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Diving Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Sai triggers, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Activate the Thopter token by tapping it, adding {U} that can only be spent to cast spells from anywhere except your hand.
Repeat.

725-2060-6702.description:
Activate Aura of Dominion by paying {1} and tapping Kilo.
Kilo triggers, causing you to proliferate and put a charge counter on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Aura of Dominion ability, untapping Kilo.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a charge counter from it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

411-713-4103-4613.notablePrerequisites: You have cycled Yidaro at least three times this game.
411-713-4103-4613.description:
Activate Yidaro's cycling ability by paying {1}{R} and discarding it.
Yidaro triggers, putting it from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Yidaro enters the battlefield, Surrak and Goreclaw triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Yidaro.
Resolve the Yidaro cycling ability, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Yidaro using Grinning Ignus's ability by paying {1} and returning Yidaro from the battlefield to your hand, adding {C}{C}{R}.
Repeat.

1308-4365-5658-6245.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You have the city's blessing or control at least six permanents.
1308-4365-5658-6245.description:
Declare Satya as an attacker. Satya triggers, creating four token copies of Ocelot Pride that are tapped and attacking and causing you to get {E}{E}.
If you don't have the city's blessing, the Ocelot Pride token gives you the city's blessing.
At the beginning of your end step, Satya triggers four times, and each Ocelot Pride you control triggers once.
Resolve the first Ocelot Pride trigger, causing you to create three 1/1 Cat creature tokens if you gained life this turn, and then causing you to create three token copies of each creature token that entered the battlefield under your control this turn, and then causing you to create a token copy of each noncreature token that entered the battlefield under your control this turn.
Repeat step 4 for each remaining trigger.
1308-4365-5658-6245.notes: You may repeat this loop during subsequent turns to get even more creature tokens and ETB triggers.

428-1694-2719-3174.notablePrerequisites:

Resolve the Ghyrson Starn trigger, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Sakashima of a Thousand Faces triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Ghyrson Starn triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Repeat from step 4.

Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.

Activate Hollow One by paying {R} and sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}{R}.
If you cast Hollow One from your graveyard, Hollow One is not exiled by Abandoned Sarcophagus due to Infinite Reflection removing Hollow One's cycling ability.

1283-1545-2034-4078-4242.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 4.

Activate Chainer by paying {3} and 3 life, returning Su-Chi to the battlefield from your graveyard.
When Su-Chi enters the battlefield, Trostani triggers, causing you to gain life equal to Su-Chi's toughness.
Repeat.

2335-3807.notablePrerequisites: Swift Reconfiguration attached to Barrenton Medic.
2335-3807.description:
Whenever damage would be dealt to you or a permanent you control, activate Barrenton Medic's first ability by tapping it, preventing the next 1 damage dealt to that target.
Activate Barrenton Medic's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat as necessary.

152-3492-3609.notablePrerequisites: Coretapper does not have summoning sickness.
152-3492-3609.description:
Activate Cogwork Assembler by paying {7}, creating a token copy of Coretapper with haste.
Activate the token Coretapper's first ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on Magistrate's Scepter.
 Activate the token Coretapper's second ability by sacrificing it, putting two charge counters on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

122-2292-2324-5170.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Phyrexian Delver.
Proper Burial triggers, causing you to gain life equal to Phyrexian Delver's toughness.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Junji.
Proper Burial and Junji trigger.
Resolve the Proper Burial trigger, causing you to gain life equal to Junji's toughness.
Resolve the Junji trigger, causing you to lose 2 life and to put Phyrexian Delver from your graveyard onto the battlefield under your control.
Phyrexian Delver enters the battlefield, causing you to return Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield and lose five life.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 4, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

651-4046-4337.description:

Task Force triggers, giving itself +0/+3 untill end of turn.
